verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Meilisearch ships as a single dependency-free binary for Linux, macOS, and Windows. It installs via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or source, with official Docker images, Helm charts, and production guidance (reverse proxy, systemd, master key). Independent users report running it themselves: ~80M documents on a Hetzner box, 1M records via a one-click Coolify Docker install on an $8/mo instance, and the core engine used in a local indexer. Missing for 10: no evidence on open-source licensing terms for the self-hosted build, and high-availability clustering is only evidenced for Cloud, with community noting self-hosted does not scale beyond one machine.
